notes.title: Food Truck Empire - Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Emperors! 🍔[/h2]
[i][h3]Play free Food Truck Empire Demo right now! 🔥[/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/479754ecc38fae43522b3dfddcfaad28a6b76bd2.png[/img]

[b]We hope you're having a great holiday time! [/b]
Some changes have been introduced to the demo and we hope you'll like them - this is a smaller update but we hope you'll enjoy it nonetheless!

[list]
[*] 🍔 [b]Settings[/b] have been added to the "ESC" menu!  
[*] [b]6 Winter-themed stickers[/b] have been added to the customization screen
[*] Small [b]quality of life[/b] changes have been added
[/list]
[i]As we want to highlight the amazing effect your feedback has on our game [b]every change that resulted from your feedback[/b] will receive an appropriate [b]burger icon[/b]! [/i]

Thank you for your feedback everyone! 💝

⚠️ Creating Food Truck Empire is an immensely satisfying process but we couldn't done it without you. Make sure to let us know about your comments, ideas, suggestions - pretty much any and all feedback. We believe in player-facing development and we want to hear from you whenever we can. 

[h3]Have fun Emperors! ❤️[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved stability of the game engine
[*] Fixed the Customers irregular spawns during different day cycles and after game loads

[*] Bowl ingredient branches adjustments (two ingredients branches need to be valid now)

[*] UI refresh rate optimization
[*] Visual adjustments to certain city locations (HQ)
